title: In the golden sensitivity table, every cell equals the base-case equity value. A correctly working data table, or any explicit equity-value-by-WACC/growth grid, would vary across rows and columns, so a correct solution fails the cell-by-cell check.
evidence: gt 'DCF_Income Approach'!K27:O31 all = 28810.1725164556 even though K26:O26 = 0.1175..0.1375 WACC and J27:J31 = 1%..3% growth; J26 = D29 = 28810.17.
confirmation: Golden 'DCF_Income Approach'!K27:O31 are TABLE cells driven by C18 (terminal growth) and C21 (WACC), which feed the terminal value D25. All 25 cached values are 28810.17 (= D29), so any working sensitivity grid with varying values mismatches these compared cells.
